summary: This video showcases a Dauntless team setup used against the Fire Guardian boss in Crown Contest. The lineup consists of Nastjenka, Kurvida, Maashtur, Guinavivre, and Astaion, achieving over 3.1 billion total damage. The creator outlines specific gear choices, stats (such as Resistance and Accuracy), and ultimate skill timing for the team.
